messages:
Leah: FYI I pushed a short PR to clarify export retention wording and add a brief migration example for older SDK calls. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612
Omar: saw it. Legal asks we avoid absolute guarantees about deletion timing. propose: 'data is retained consistent with our documented retention policy and applicable law.'
Tess: also include a short note about redaction: customers can request redacted exports. keep it high level (no infra details).
Leah: will reword. planning to add both current SDK + legacy snippet and a tiny troubleshooting bullet for common export errors.
Omar: for the migration note, show a before/after code diff: older param `retention_days` -> new `retention_policy`. also mention that servers may reject unsupported param names in strict-mode.
Tess: sample snippets are fine. here's a compact example to include in the docs (feel free to adapt):
```
# current SDK
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='acct-xyz', retention_policy='audit:45d', redacted=True)
print(resp.url)

# legacy SDK (migration)
# before:
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='acct-xyz', retention_days=45)
# after:
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='acct-xyz', retention_policy='audit:45d')
```

curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct-xyz","retention_policy":"audit:45d","redacted":true}'
```
Leah: added Omar's legal phrasing and Tess's redaction note. also added a cross-ref to the SOC2 FAQ and a short caveat: 'exported content may be subject to legal hold or other regulatory obligations.'
Omar: perfect. tiny editorial: change 'redacted exports' -> 'exports with redaction applied' (for clarity).
Leah: done. added a one-line troubleshooting tip: if the export URL returns 403, check tenant export permissions, and confirm the tenant's retention configuration allows requested export retention.
docs-bot: Preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/612/export-redaction-migration 1: preview expires in 7 days.
Tess: LGTM from docs side. would be great if engineering can run the snippet in the SDK CI smoke test.
Leah: filing a follow-up checkbox in the PR for running the snippet in CI and adding a changelog entry. requesting final legal review from @Omar.
Omar: +1 from legal pending LegalBot automated checks. I'll approve after the bot clears the new phrasing.
Leah: thanks team 1: merging after legal bot OKs.
